# Atlantic Bear
> Professional custom websites for UAE businesses. Designed, built, and launched in 3-5 days. Fully managed and optimized for client acquisition.

## Navigation
- [Home Page](https://atlanticbear.com/): Explains our unique risk-free offer where we build a free demo of your website before you pay anything, details our design process, and features client results.
- [Pricing Plans](https://atlanticbear.com/pricing): Transparent pricing for UAE businesses. Features the Launch Plan (AED 1,450 + AED 150/mo managed) and the Growth Plan (AED 6,500 + AED 300/mo managed) with full feature checklists.
- [Client Testimonials](https://atlanticbear.com/testimonials): Real results and case studies, including before-and-after video and layout reviews for clients like Sonder Training Group.
- [Contact Details](https://atlanticbear.com/contact): Reach us via email at officialatlanticbear@gmail.com, via Instagram @officialatlanticbear, or schedule a direct meeting.
- [Book a Call](https://atlanticbear.com/booking): Start your project by booking a direct call with our team.
